title: Handbook of Qi Along the Haft
summary: Teaches a circulating student to pass qi along the haft into the chop and the throw.

title: Course in the Two-Axe Carry
summary: Shows a student with a guard skill how to fight and throw with an axe in each hand.

title: Treatise on Spin and Reach
summary: Develops range judgment, many-turn throws and pinning volleys for students who already move well.

title: Workbook of the Thrown Bit and Step
summary: Joins release, footwork and quick follow-up cuts into drills for a Warrior with working step skills.

title: Canon of the Hooking Beard
summary: A full course in hooking, pulling and levering opponents and their guards with the axe's beard.

title: Lessons in Release at the Wrist Turn
summary: Refines the one-motion draw and throw and the close wrist work that goes with it.

title: Primer of Qi-Tempered Hatchet Work
summary: Teaches tempering the bit with qi so it splits wood, rings on plate and pierces mail.

title: Handbook of the Moving Axeman
summary: Trains a Warrior to chop, throw and charge at speed across open ground without breaking stride.
